title: Payload — entity.alias_proposed
$comment: Asserts two identifiers name the same thing. The lexicographically smaller identifier goes in `entity`; without that rule the same pair yields two events nothing can deduplicate. additionalProperties is true by design: the versioning rules require that a new optional field survives a node that cannot interpret it, preserved byte-exactly for the digest. Every envelope field name is forbidden here (set to false): the convention that a payload never duplicates the envelope is enforced by the schema, not left to prose.
